fact: The Ministry of Territorial Administration reported more than 121,000 civil-status documents issued to internally displaced people in 2025 against 65,000 planned, per the Primature evaluation of its 2025 contract of objectives.

The World Bank SASPP page says work has been initiated to support interoperability between the Social Registry, Internally Displaced Persons databases and the Unique Identifier System being developed under the WURI project.
AMADE Mondiale says its 2022-2024 pilot with ATT regularised 10,000 children without birth certificates, including more than 4,000 internally displaced children.
ANOTEL, applying decree 2023-1721 of 15 December 2023, states that the refugee identity card and refugee attestation issued by CONAREF are the only documents accepted for refugees to buy a SIM card.

Decree 2023-1721 of 15 December 2023, as read by Africa Data Protection, lets a subscriber identify for a SIM with a refugee identity card or a refugee certificate from the National Commission for Refugees.
Orange Burkina Faso's 2017-2024 CSR report, as reported by C'Finance, says the company supplied 10,000 CNIB national identity cards to internally displaced people.
The minister said mobile teams will go to internally displaced people, elderly, disabled and detained people for the unique identifier enrolment launched on 11 November 2026.
